introduction.text: The Chiostro del Bramante, or Cloisters of Bramante, is an Italian Renaissance building in Rome, notable for its architectural design and its connection to significant Renaissance figures.

history.description: Cardinal Oliviero Carafa commissioned the construction of the Chiostro del Bramante around 1500.

design.description: The building was designed by the renowned architect Donato Bramante.

art.description: From the first floor of the Chiostro del Bramante, visitors can view 'The Sibyls,' a fresco painting by Raphael located in the adjacent church of Santa Maria della Pace.

relatedPeople.name: Raphael
relatedPeople.relationship: Artist of 'The Sibyls' fresco visible from the building
